query: select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',now(),'scope','hlvujbrmfdlrfxdjwsmb read-only catalogue preflight','counts',jsonb_build_object('works',(select count(*) from public.works),'editions',(select count(*) from public.editions),'descriptions',(select count(*) from public.catalog_work_descriptions),'metadata',(select count(*) from public.catalog_edition_metadata)),'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.conrelid::regclass::text,'name',c.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid)) order by c.conrelid,c.conname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid in ('public.works'::regclass,'public.editions'::regclass,'public.catalog_work_descriptions'::regclass,'public.catalog_edition_metadata'::regclass)),'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'trigger',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid),'function',p.proname,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) order by t.tgrelid,t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid in ('public.works'::regclass,'public.editions'::regclass,'public.catalog_work_descriptions'::regclass,'public.catalog_edition_metadata'::regclass))) as preflight;

triggers.name: catalog_preserve_reviewed_work_author
triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_preserve_reviewed_work_author BEFORE UPDATE OF author_id ON public.works FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog_guard_reviewed_identity()

triggers.name: catalog_preserve_reviewed_edition_identity
triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER catalog_preserve_reviewed_edition_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF work_id, title, language, isbn_13, isbn_10, open_library_edition_id ON public.editions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION catalog_guard_reviewed_identity()

constraints.name: works_work_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((work_type IS NULL) OR (work_type = ANY (ARRAY['novel'::text, 'novella'::text, 'short_story'::text, 'collection'::text, 'audiobook_original'::text])))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: catalog_description_usable_text
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(text, '<[^>]*>'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), '&(nbsp|#160);'::text, ' '::text, 'gi'::text))) >= 20) AND (lower(btrim(text)) !~ '^(no (book )?description( available| found)?|description (not available|unavailable|missing)|geen (boek)?beschrijving( beschikbaar| gevonden)?|samenvatting (ontbreekt|niet beschikbaar)|503 service unavailable|429 too many requests)[.! ]*$'::text)))

constraints.name: catalog_work_descriptions_bound_author_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (bound_author_id) REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: catalog_work_descriptions_work_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (work_id) REFERENCES works(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: catalog_edition_metadata_bound_author_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (bound_author_id) REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: catalog_edition_metadata_edition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (edition_id) REFERENCES editions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (work_id) REFERENCES works(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
